update @bstcong set datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate(), user_id0 = @@userId, user_id2 = @@userId update @bstcong set datetime0 = b.datetime0, user_id0 = b.user_id0 from @bstcong a join hrbstcong b on a.id = b.id and a.ngay = b.ngay and a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong delete hrbstcong from hrbstcong a where exists(select 1 from @bstcong b where a.id = b.id and a.ngay = b.ngay and a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong) insert into hrbstcong select * from @bstcong
select '$Processed' as message
